description: This is a Java unit test file for the class 'DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponse', testing its immutability, null handling, and conversion logic for exceptions to HTTP responses.

classes.name: DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponse, testing immutability, null input handling, and exception to HTTP response conversion.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes the headerTranslator before any tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponse is immutable, including the HeaderTranslator dependency.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullHeaderTranslator
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to getInstance throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: tryToConvertNullException
